udt_error_enum_v0.name: Error

udt_union_v0.doc: Storage keys. `Pool` lives in *persistent* storage (match funds must outlive\nthe contract instance so they are never stranded); `Admin`/`Token`/`Paused`/\ntotals live in *instance* storage so they share the instance TTL.
udt_union_v0.name: DataKey

void_v0.doc: Running total donated across every pool.
void_v0.name: TotalDonated

void_v0.doc: Running total matched across every pool.
void_v0.name: TotalMatched

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A single matched-donation pool, keyed in storage by its 32-byte `pool_id`.

A sponsor funds `total_funded` minor units of `token` into the contract;
`remaining` is what is still available to match. Every donor gift is paid
straight through the contract to `cause` together with a 1:1 match drawn
from `remaining` (capped at `remaining`).
udt_struct_v0.name: Pool

fields.doc: Payout address that receives every gift + its match for this pool.
fields.name: cause

fields.doc: Lifetime total donated by donors through this pool.
fields.name: donated

fields.doc: Number of donations processed through this pool.
fields.name: donations

fields.doc: Lifetime total matched out of the pool to the cause.
fields.name: matched

fields.doc: Match funds still available to pay out (decremented on each match).
fields.name: remaining

fields.doc: Address that funded the match pool (and may top it up).
fields.name: sponsor

fields.doc: Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) of the pool asset (XLM SAC by default).
fields.name: token

fields.doc: Lifetime total ever funded into the match pool (monotonic).
fields.name: total_funded

udt_struct_v0.doc: Returned by `donate` so the app can record the exact on-chain split without\nre-reading the pool.
udt_struct_v0.name: Receipt

fields.doc: The donor's gift, in the token's minor units.
fields.name: donated

fields.doc: The matching amount drawn from the pool (`min(gift, remaining)`).
fields.name: matched

fields.doc: Match funds left in the pool after this gift.
fields.name: remaining

fields.doc: Total paid to the cause this gift (`donated + matched`).
fields.name: total

function_v0.doc: One-time setup. Records the admin (the deployer) and the default token\n(the XLM Stellar Asset Contract), and unpauses the contract.
function_v0.name: initialize

function_v0.doc:
Fund (or top up) the match pool `pool_id` for `cause` with `amount` of the
configured token, locking it in the contract. Creates the pool on first
call (binding its `sponsor` and `cause`); accumulates on later calls by
the same sponsor for the same cause. Returns the updated pool.

Auth: the sponsor's signature, which also covers the inner SAC
`transfer(sponsor -> contract)`.
function_v0.name: fund_pool

function_v0.doc:
Donate `amount` to the pool's cause. The contract pulls the gift from the
donor, then pays the cause `gift + match` where `match = min(gift,
remaining)`. Both legs settle atomically. Returns the on-chain split.

Auth: the donor's signature, which also covers the inner SAC
`transfer(donor -> contract)`. The contract authorizes its own payout.
function_v0.name: donate

function_v0.doc: Replace the contract's own code (admin-gated). Enables shipping fixes\nwithout migrating pooled funds.
function_v0.name: upgrade
